name: gpui-bridge-monorepo
description: Native desktop UIs driven from another language: Rust host + Node, React and Python clients

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && cargo build -p gpui-bridge-host && pnpm build
scripts.build: pnpm --filter gpui-bridge build && pnpm --filter gpui-bridge-react build
scripts.test: pnpm test:host && pnpm test:node && pnpm test:react && pnpm test:python
scripts.wheel: pnpm host:release && node scripts/stage-host.mjs --to python && python packages/client-python/build_wheel.py
